summary: Iteration 9 completed for vegetable scanner expansion and regressions. Backend pytest passed 12/12 across auth, JPEG/PNG/WEBP validation paths, real karela scan with hint, no-hint scan, scan history persistence/readability, Gemini chat and voice contracts. Mobile-web Playwright at 390x844 passed login, tabs, weather/mandi visibility, scanner gallery upload, plant hint submission, full result card fields, Gemini badge, history detail open, chat Devanagari response presence, settings Gemini status, and no horizontal overflow.

minor.issue: Observed one flaky run in legacy test where AI returned numbered symptoms collapsed into one line (1 symptom parsed). Immediate retry passed; parser remains sensitive to model formatting style.

action_items: Harden /api/ai/scan section parser to split inline numbered lists (e.g., '1. ... 2. ...') into separate symptoms/causes/remedies consistently.
Address frontend eslint warning in AppContext useMemo dependencies to prevent stale callbacks in future updates.
Optional maintainability: split /app/backend/server.py (>900 lines) into focused modules to reduce regression risk.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/backend/server.py is very large (>900 lines), increasing coupling across auth/AI/weather/voice flows.
Scanner input validation correctly blocks invalid base64 and unsupported data URI mime prefixes for /api/ai/scan.
Frontend scanner testIDs coverage is strong for automation (plant hint, result card, history cards, model badge).
No MOCKED API flow detected during this run.
seed_data_creation: Authenticated scanner tests created additional scan history entries for QA account using /tmp/karela_powdery_mildew.png.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Public preview URL used from frontend/.env (EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). Real karela PNG + plant_hint=करेला returned plant name/category/diagnosis/confidence/severity/symptoms/causes/remedies and Gemini model badge. No-hint flow also returned valid conservative output.
rca_of_issue: Flaky symptom-count failure was reproduced once in legacy test and passed on retry. Root cause: model sometimes emits numbered items in a single paragraph; current parser primarily splits by lines, so inline numbering can collapse list count. Mitigation: add regex split on numbered/bullet patterns before truncation.
